## Overview

The head of the Flesh Architects — the being who oversees all experiments and reports directly to the Crimson Covenant's Inner Circle. Named for the first time in Elena Vance's journal found at Gamma-7.

## Key Facts

- Ordered the decommissioning of Gamma-7
- Ordered consolidation of all monster integration research into the "main project"
- Identity, true name, and appearance are unknown
- Rumored to have undergone extensive self-implantation — possibly no longer fully mortal
- May be the most heavily modified Flesh Architect, potentially having fused multiple magical items and crystals into their body

## Secrets (GM Only)

The Chief Architect's identity is deliberately kept vague. The GM can decide who they are when the campaign reaches a point where direct interaction is needed. Possible reveals:
- A figure from a PC's past
- An original founder of the Flesh Architects
- Something no longer fully human/humanoid

## Plot Hooks

- The Chief Architect is a named target for Zan (who seeks to destroy the Flesh Architects)
- Learning the Chief Architect's identity could lead to the Primary Facility
- The Chief Architect may know about Sophie (Subject 241) and her fate
